#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <string>
#include <sstream>

using namespace std;

int main() {
    int w, m;
    cin >> w >> m;

    vector<int> digits;
    while (m > 0) {
        digits.push_back(m % w);
        m /= w;
    }

    if (digits.empty()) {
        cout << "YES" << endl;
        return 0;
    }

    for (size_t i = 0; i < digits.size(); ++i) {
        int d = digits[i];
        if (d > w / 2) {
            digits[i] = w - d;
            if (i + 1 == digits.size()) {
                digits.push_back(0);
            }
            digits[i + 1] += 1;
        }
    }

    if (digits.back() == 1) {
        digits.push_back(0);
    }

    for (int d : digits) {
        if (d > 1) {
            cout << "NO" << endl;
            return 0;
        }
    }
    cout << "YES" << endl;
    return 0;
}
